This page separates a compact **guided route** from a **progressive map**. The route is derived from the canonical curriculum; the map starts from the high-level territories, then reveals sections and pages as you click.

- **Territories** — the main parts of the site: Understand, Build, Practice, Deepen, Reference.
- **Sections** — clicking a territory reveals its subsections; the breadcrumb or the Escape key takes you back up one level.
- **Pages** — clicking a page shows its details (purpose, sections, links); "Open the page" navigates there directly.
- **Concepts** — the "Canonical concepts" view lists the concepts from the bilingual registry versioned in `data/concepts.yml`, with their definitions, typed relationships, and resource pages.

Section headings shown in a page's details are editorial landmarks, not canonical concepts. The map must not be interpreted as a single reading order: the guided route below plays that role.

::: {.guided-route-section}

## Guided route

Six conceptual stages provide an entry point and a suggested progression. Primary links open the core pages; deep dives are optional. Pages within a stage are complementary resources, not a list of strict prerequisites.

{{< include ../includes/generated-guided-route-en.qmd >}}

::: {.guided-route-companion}

**Practical companion:** If you want to build a small GPT, follow the [guided build path](build-path.html). Corpus preparation and training-example construction form a dedicated model-learning branch, not a prerequisite for inference.

:::

:::

## Explore the resources

The progressive map replaces the former dense graph: it first shows territories, then reveals each section on click, then the pages. The "Canonical concepts" view separately presents the registry concepts. These views support exploration; they do not replace the guided route above.
